{{Top|leg}}
In [[3964 BBY]], [[Taris/Legends|Tarisian]] law enforcement used '''patrol personnel carriers''' in their pursuit of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fugitives [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]]. One of them was destroyed by a laser blast from the [[junk hauler]] [[The Last Resort (starship)|''The Last Resort'']] above the [[Taris system/Legends|Taris system's]] [[Rogue Moon]].
